title: WorkPulse event envelope v1
description: Envelope every WorkPulse event must use. Kafka arrives in Phase 3; the contract starts now.

event_id.description: Globally unique event id (e.g. evt_123). Consumers deduplicate on this — idempotency key.

version.description: Payload version; matches the .v<N> suffix of the schema file

tenant_id.description: Tenant isolation is mandatory — every event carries it

occurred_at.description: When the fact happened in the domain (not when it was published)

actor_id.description: Who caused the event (employee, system job, integration)

data.description: Domain payload, validated by the matching <domain>-<event>.v<N>.json schema
